results.pair_summary: Doc B defines the canonical Intermediate Representation (IR) data structure, lifecycle invariants, and stream flow for the runtime kernel. Doc A specifies a specialized Observation Analysis Layer module that consumes IR streams to compute divergence profiles, but redundantly defines a simplified local version of the IR type.
results.integration_rationale: Doc B serves as the foundational schema (Parent) for IR within the Delta3 Kernel ecosystem, while Doc A implements specific analytical logic (Child/Consumer). Both must be retained to preserve core type definitions and analysis capabilities. Integration requires refactoring Doc A to import and utilize Doc B's canonical IR definition instead of its local simplified version, ensuring strict schema consistency across the ObservationAnalysisLayer.
